label: Meditation III idea-of-the-infinite argument and the cogito, bridged to the maximum in being
summary: Analyst reconstruction, attribution deferred (navigation only: Descartes, Meditations II-III and the Second Replies; no source records). Formalized in TruthCore.Causality.CartesianIdeaOfInfinite over the shared GradesFrame F (IN_ACT_4, MORE_1, CAUSE_2, esse) and a separate IdeaFrame I whose primitive fields are the cogito binders Occurs and Bears, Represents (objective reality, definition 89b53040), ObjCause (cause of an idea's objective reality, definition d8e82792, not CAUSE_2), the respect inf (INFINITE_3, definition ef3ee5ec, appended to DISAMB-INFINITY) and the meditator me (definition f356048e). (1) RESULT 84ce0e39: P1 d3fcdeeb (an occurring idea borne by the meditator represents INFINITE_3), P2 0747e4f3 (the objective reality of every occurring idea has a cause), P3 3845020d (objective adequacy: whatever causes an idea's representing r is in act in r, IN_ACT_4, formally or eminently) and P4 4a9ede84 (the meditator is not in act in INFINITE_3) give 4c815f13: something other than the meditator is in act in INFINITE_3 and causes the meditator's idea of it. Non-transcription (distinctness is derived from P4); the comparator also checks a finite model where P1-P4 hold together. (2) RESULT 114e32ea (rejected reading certified): P3 is not an instance of the formal containment clause. On a one-being frame where the meditator causes its own being in act in the feature of representing INFINITE_3, containment in every cause (634a80b8) and q.4 a.2 preexistence (64498e7e) hold with P1, P2 and P4, while P3 fails and nothing is in act in INFINITE_3. (3) BRIDGE to the God-existence node. Proved (result 6de4168f): 4c815f13 with the new open bridge 1a289b83 (whatever is in act in INFINITE_3 is maximal in being, MAXIME_ENS_1) and the existing genus principle at being da09703b gives the quarta via conclusion 0881e859 (something maximal in being causes the being of every other being). 0881e859 is a premise of the existing GOD_4-existence arguments 678ff65f, 5d2b7c6e and 0e8e37dc (8626f8a5), so a new conditional support option for 8626f8a5 results: P1-P4, 1a289b83 and da09703b in place of 0881e859, with the other seven premises of the chosen route unchanged (each route keeps the open naming premise 1ec205ed, 7067553d, excluded middle, 09c6d5f0, eaa4c679 and its transfer/comparative premises). The bridge is a premise, not a definitional equality: inf and esse are unrelated respects. Positive warrant for 1a289b83 under the INFINITE_3 meaning (perfection without limit): a thing surpassed in being by another falls short of that other's being, which is a limit of its perfection; open in the frame. No existing statement mentions the inf respect, so none yields 1a289b83 without a further premise relating inf to esse or MoreIn (observation, no countermodel certified). Not available: INFINITE_1 (b0132989 runs from GOD_4 to INFINITE_1; using it for existence would need the converse, and Infinite is a predicate of beings, not the respect inf). The stronger reading 'infinite in every perfection' (in act and unsurpassed in every respect) entails 1a289b83 by instantiation and is not needed; not registered. Rejected: a direct naming bridge 'whatever is in act in INFINITE_3 is GOD_4' would give 8626f8a5 by a single application (invariant 16), a stronger bare leaf above a near-transcription (#1842); the maximality route instead joins routes that carry their own naming premise 1ec205ed. (4) COGITO. Existing premises supply an anonymous bearer: ThoughtOccurs e81971f1 with the bearer principle 30e6e01c gives Thinks x for some x. New: the first-person 22954087 (the meditator bears some occurring episode, ThinkingRootFork.Thinks at me) strengthens e81971f1 (result 2e0da6d9, relation registered; strictness witnessed only by the existing subjectless control 6cffb105, not registered). It does not supply world-indexed existence (EveryBearerExistsAt c821487b is separate: Occurs is not world-indexed), concreteness, finitude (P4 is separate), substance, or identity of the anonymous bearer with the meditator. In the Meditation III argument the cogito supplies only the 'Bears me e' part of P1; P1 entails 22954087 by dropping the Represents conjunct (immediate, not registered). (5) RIVALS (substantive-objection standard). Objection on P3, and through it on the P1/P3 pair: target P3 at r = INFINITE_3; mechanism: the meditator forms the content 'infinite' by negating the limits of finite perfections it has, so the meditator is a cause of the idea's objective reality without being in act in INFINITE_3; independent justification: finite reasoners demonstrably form concepts of unboundedness by negating a bound (no largest natural number, an endless successor sequence) without being unbounded; relevance: exactly the step ObjCause c e inf to InAct c inf fails when c is the meditator. Formal locus: the configuration of result 114e32ea is this rival's (the meditator causes its idea's objective reality and lacks INFINITE_3), so the rival is model-witnessed compatible with formal containment, PEPC, P1, P2 and P4; with P3 and P4 it is inconsistent. Reply on record (navigation: Meditation III): the idea of the infinite is positive and prior to that of the finite, so negation-formed content represents only 'not finite', not INFINITE_3. The relevant difference claimed is positive versus negative content; if granted, the objection moves to P1 (whether the meditator's idea represents INFINITE_3 rather than unboundedness). So the objection forces rejecting the positive-content reading of P1 or P3; it does not by itself say which. Unresolved, kept open. P4: Descartes's own worry that the meditator might be potentially infinite does not target P3 here, since P3 requires act (IN_ACT_4), not potency. No substantive objection identified to P2 beyond the general causal-principle disputes already on file for causal premises, or to the bridge 1a289b83 under the INFINITE_3 meaning. Clear-and-distinct perception is not a premise, so the Cartesian-circle objection has no target. (6) Earlier rejected readings retained: finitude as 'every thinker lacks INFINITE_3' (stronger than needed and would make the cause a non-thinker); ObjCause is not added as a sense of the Cause disambiguation because it relates a being to an idea's content and no argument passes between it and CausesIn (semantics preflight: single sense in all four arguments). (7) Meditation V is not duplicated (merged #1836, meditationFive). (8) Duper discovery (premise pool all, explicit targets): before and after, 0881e859 and 8626f8a5 stay unresolved; after, the conclusion 4c815f13 is rediscovered from exactly P1-P4 (filtered as the existing argument), while objective adequacy 3845020d and the bridge 1a289b83 stay unresolved, so no pooled statement, formal containment and PEPC included, supplies either.
blocker: Next tests: (a) split P1 into positive-content (represents INFINITE_3) and negative-content (represents unboundedness) siblings, formalize the negation-formed rival (the meditator is the cause of its idea's objective reality) with its checked incompatibility with P3 and P4, and record it as an alternative to P3; (b) the mode-asymmetric reading of P3 (formal in the idea's object, formal or eminent in the cause) over TermSenseForks.ActFrame with an explicit sense bridge; (c) register 'infinite in every perfection' and its strength order to 1a289b83 if a route needs perfections other than being; (d) warrant for 1a289b83 from an explicit limit premise (whatever is surpassed in being is limited in perfection) rather than as a bare bridge. The new support option for GOD_4 existence still passes through the open naming premise 1ec205ed and the uniqueness premises of the existing quarta via routes; the Meditation III cause is not shown unique.
